name: Hyundai Motor Group Saemangeum AI Data Center / Innovation Hub
notes: Hyundai announced an MOU with the Korean government and Jeonbuk State to invest nearly KRW 9 trillion from 2026 in Saemangeum, including an AI data center for autonomous driving and robotics data. Official Hyundai source describes the site as the Saemangeum area of Gunsan City; Invest Korea describes Saemangeum as a national project connecting Gunsan and Buan, so this is included for Buan coverage as a cross-boundary Saemangeum project.

name: Gimje Smart Farm Innovation Valley Big Data Center
notes: Government/Yonhap report says the Gimje Smart Farm Innovation Valley includes a Big Data Center for collecting smart-farm data and supporting AI analysis. This is a sectoral big-data facility, not a hyperscale colocation or cloud data center.

name: SGC Gunsan AI Data Center
developer: SGC Energy / SGC Green Power; KT and Mirae Asset Securities participating
notes: Planned for Gunsan National Industrial Complex 2 on SGC Green Power land. First 40MW modular phase is planned to start construction in late 2026 and begin operations in Q1 2028, then expand in stages to 300MW.

name: Hyundai Motor Group Saemangeum AI Data Center / Innovation Hub
notes: Hyundai announced an MOU with the Korean government and Jeonbuk State for a nearly KRW 9 trillion Saemangeum investment beginning in 2026; the hub includes an AI data center, robotics manufacturing, hydrogen, solar, and AI smart-city elements. MK reported the AI data center and solar facilities are slated to start construction in 2027 and target completion in 2029.

name: Jeongeup Financial AI Convergence Cluster Data Center
notes: Jeongeup City signed an MOU with Fount for a Financial AI Convergence Cluster. The report references practical planning around surplus heat from data center operations, but does not disclose a capacity or construction schedule; treated as planned with checked-date evidence.

name: Jeonbuk AI Data Center
developer: Jeonbuk AI Data Center (JBAIDC) SPC; KT and Microsoft Korea consortium participation
notes: Jeonju City and JBAIDC signed an MOU to build and operate the Jeonbuk AI Data Center in Palbok-dong, Deokjin-gu. Planned investment is KRW 300.7 billion on an 11,599 sqm site with 9.8MW power capacity and 2027 completion target.

name: Moreh Physical AI Data Center and Research Hub
notes: Moreh signed an investment agreement with North Jeolla for a physical AI data center project in Jeonju, investing KRW 20.6 billion to establish an AI data center and research hub using AMD and Tenstorrent chips with Moreh software.

name: LG Uplus Jeonju IDC
notes: DCD reports LG Uplus operates regional centers including Jeonju among its Korean colocation data center footprint. Capacity and precise address were not disclosed in the public source found.
